title: Lost Mary BM600 Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Blue Razz Lemonade Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods offer a bright, sparkling fusion of tart Blue Raspberry and a zesty, citrus-forward Lemonade base. The sweet berry notes contrast cleanly against the sharp citrus twist on the exhale, providing a refreshing all-day vape. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs* per pod depending on usage. Designed for a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, they provide a satisfying experience with no need for refilling or coil changes. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these pods are quick and clean to install. Simply click a pod into the device and enjoy consistent flavour and vapour with every puff. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
